title: Roof Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In February 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Gresham, OR. The crew tore off every layer of old roofing down to the wood deck, laid synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new valley metal, new wall flashings, new pipe flashings and new roof vents.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roof down to the wood deck
Installed synthetic underlayment, painted drip edge and gable flashing, and a self-sealing starter course
Installed CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, nailed in a 4 nail pattern, with standard ridge cap
New front wall and sidewall flashing, 24 inch valley metal, and new double seal flashings on the vent pipes
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic roof vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard for nails

faqs.question: Did the old roof come off on this Gresham job?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every layer of the old roof came off down to the wood deck before the new underlayment and shingles went on.

faqs.question: What shingles were installed?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, over synthetic underlayment, with standard ridge cap.
